rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose medical term for hands-on patient care in a clinical setting.

example.traditional: 呢份工作要有臨床經驗。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 zok3 jiu3 jau5 lam4 cong4 ging1 jim6

rows.note: Use this for a professional approach that is emotionally detached, objective, and analytical.

example.english: They took a clinical, objective approach to the medical incident.
example.traditional: 面對呢宗醫療事故，佢仍然保持冷靜客觀。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 ne1 zung1 ji1 liu4 si6 gu3 keoi5 jing4 jin4 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6 haak3 gun1

rows.note: Use this when clinical means belonging to or taking place in a clinic, including a medical or legal clinic.

example.english: This service is only available in a clinical setting.
example.traditional: 呢項服務只限於診所提供。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 fuk6 mou6 zi2 haan6 jyu1 can2 so2 tai4 gung1
